facts_of_case: The petitioner is the jeth of the prosecutrix who was married to his younger brother. The marriage did not succeed due to temperamental differences, resulting in various litigations. A complaint under Sections 406/498A/34 IPC is pending. The prosecutrix filed a complaint with the DCP-South on 21.07.2020, which led to FIR bearing No.No.296/2020 being registered.

legal_principles.principle: A complainant ought to report the incident to the police on the same day itself.
legal_principles.held: Rather she filed a complaint after about 8 to 9 days and that too of molestation but whereas in her statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. she improved herself and alleged rape was committed upon her once but thereafter on the same day under Section 161 Cr.P.C., she said rape was committed on two occasions.
use_in: cases involving delayed reporting of incidents

legal_principles.principle: A complainant's statement under Section 164 Cr.P.C. may improve upon previous statements.
legal_principles.held: She improved herself and levelled allegations of rape, against her jeth, committed a month earlier.

use_for_drafting: responding to allegations of rape and cruelty
advising on Hindu Marriage Act provisions
